nodes.name: Webhook - L1 Notify
nodes.notes: Called by WF1 router or directly by triage-api for low/medium alerts. Token from env credential reference, never hardcoded, never logged.

nodes.name: Validate Token
nodes.notes: Real shared-secret validation against $env secret. Reject missing/wrong, accept exact. Never log token. Security: no full_log, no secrets, no destructive, no autonomous containment, fail-open.

nodes.name: Format Notification
nodes.notes: Summary-only notification, no full_log, no raw logs. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

nodes.name: Email - L1 Alert
nodes.notes: L1 notification. Fail-open: triage-api already audited attempt/result. No secrets in payload.

nodes.name: Slack - L1 Alert
nodes.notes: Optional Slack notification for L1. Fail-open if misconfigured. No destructive actions.
